title: Sandy

inlines.v: SAND'Y, adjective 1. Abounding with sand; full of sand; covered or sprinkled with sand; as a sandy desert or plain; a sandy road or soil. 2. Consisting of sand; not firm or solid; as a sandy foundation. 3. Of the color of sand; of a yellowish red color; as sandy hair.
